session_dir_unsafe: ERROR: {path} is not a safe directory owned by you; remove it and try again.

open_failed: FAILED to open a session on '{host}': {error}
shell_state_lost: (WARNING: new shell; previous variables/cd were lost)
shell_ended: (the shell exited; the next command opens another one on the same login)
local_no_ssh: FAILED: the Local host does not use SSH/Telnet or an interactive shell
no_commands: FAILED: give at least one --command or --commands-file
session_list_line: {sid}  host={host} ip={ip} mode={mode} cmds={cmds} idle={idle}s/{idle_limit}s alive={alive}
session_description: Access inventory devices (SSH/Telnet): run = one-shot batch; open/exec/close = persistent session.
help_run: Connect, run the command(s) and disconnect, in a single call
help_host_id: Integer host ID in the inventory
help_host: Unique name or legacy alias of the host
help_commands_file: File with one command per line
help_shell: Linux: Netmiko interactive shell with PTY (only for commands that need a terminal; no exit code)
help_expect: Regex of the expected prompt (shell), if it changes
help_timing: Shell: read by time (continuous/paged command: ping, torch)
help_open: Reuse the host's live session or open one (prints the SESSION_ID)
help_new: Open another session even if one is alive
help_exec: Run command(s) in the host's session (reuse or open), the DEFAULT MODE
help_exec_host_id: Host ID: reuse its live session or open one
help_exec_host: Unique name or legacy alias of the host (same)
help_close_host_id: Close the session(s) of this host
terminal_link_description: Link that opens a host's web terminal (SSH/Telnet) in the console.
help_hostname: Unique hostname or legacy alias of the host
help_method: Method (default: the main one in the inventory)
help_port: Port (when the host has the same method on different ports)
help_all_links: One link for each registered SSH/Telnet method
terminal_host_not_found: ERROR: host '{host}' is not in the inventory ({error})
terminal_no_ssh_telnet: ERROR: host {host} has no SSH/Telnet registered (only {method})
task_no_key: task '{task}' has no key provisioned on host {host_id}
task_key_backup_failed:
pre-change backup failed on host {host_id}; nothing was changed:
{output}
api_not_api_method: WARNING: '{host}' is not marked as method:api in the inventory.
api_help_host_id: Integer ID of the MikroTik host in the inventory
api_help_host: Unique name or legacy alias of the MikroTik host
api_query_failed: FAILED to query the API of '{host}': {error}
log_handshake_failed: persistent shell did not answer the handshake: {output}
log_shell_unavailable: persistent shell unavailable ({error}); using one exec channel per command (stateless)
log_shell_ended: shell exited during the command (exit {rc}); the next command starts a new shell
log_shell_killed: shell unrecoverable after timeout; killed; the next command starts a new shell
log_reconnecting: connection dropped; reconnecting before the command
